'''Fauler''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] agent of the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].

==Biography==
In [[3643 BBY]], he was stationed at the [[Republic Embassy (Tatooine)|Republic Embassy]] in [[Anchorhead/Legends|Anchorhead]], [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] as an official [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] representative. Covertly, he was [[SIS operation on Tatooine|investigating]] [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka]] activities on the planet. When an ex-corporate accountant [[Kamus Orden]] stole several Czerka financial documents revealing an existence of an abandoned expensive [[Czerka Secret Weapons Division 7|facility]] researching a "type-seven device" - a technology believed to have a potential for massacring planets, agent Fauler decided to look for an outside help. When an exceptionally skilled Republic individual arrived to Tatooine, Fauler sent a droid [[N0-HX]] to [[Anchorhead Spaceport|Anchorhead spaceport]], to invite the individual to the Embassy.<ref name="Timely Arrival" />

However Fauler's duties as the Republic representative delayed him in town, and the individual came to the [[Republic Embassy (Tatooine)|Embassy]] first, finding [[Kamus Orden]] and [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka]] assassins searching for him there. By the time Fauler arrived, Czerka intruders were already dispatched by the Republic individual, and, impressed by their fighting skills, Fauler hired them to help with investigating Czerka.<ref name="Timely Arrival" /> 

In search for Czerka's old facility, Fauler made an enemy in [[Gayem Leksende]], head of Czerka's special enforcement branch,<ref name="Timely Arrival" /> sent to Tatooine to stop the Republic from discovering corporate secrets. Gayem contacted Fauler and his associates on several occasions to intimidate them, however the two of them never got a chance to meet face to face.<ref name="The Thing Czerka Found">{{TORcite|type=faction|[[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]]|The Thing Czerka Found|[[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]}}</ref>

After the individual Fauler hired got him the old data from [[Jundland Czerka facility]],<ref name="Timely Arrival" /> and from an [[Grommik Kurthson|another ex-corporate]] living on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]],<ref name="Last One Out">{{TORcite|type=faction|[[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]]|Last One Out|[[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]}}</ref> it was decided to move the base of operations further into the desert; Fauler and [[Kamus Orden]] traveled to the [[Outpost Salara]], where stationed at the local [[SIS forward outpost|SIS office]] until the end of the [[SIS operation on Tatooine|operation]]. From there, Fauler equipped his associate with a [[Terrain scanner/Legends|ground scanner]] and tasked them with using it across the [[Jundland Chasm/Legends|northern Jundland Chasm]], to determine the pattern of sand shift over the years and pinpoint the location of the base. Keeping a radio contact, he later informed them of an unidentified energy signature near their location, which turned out to be a Czerka's [[Czerka listening outpost|listening post]].<ref name="Field Trip" />

With the scans analyzed, Fauler and his team were able to locate the lost [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka]]'s [[Czerka Secret Weapons Division 7|facility]]. He explained to his new associate how to get the needed door codes from old Czerka relays scattered across the [[Dune Sea/Legends|Dune Sea]], and waited for them at the [[SIS forward outpost|SIS base]] along with [[Kamus Orden]]. When his associate successfully found the facility and dealt with Czerka and the [[The Imprisoned One's mind prison|device]] they studied, they reported back to Fauler who paid for their work and expressed the gratitude of [[Republic Strategic Information Service]].<ref name="The Thing Czerka Found" /> Afterwards, Fauler took Kamus Orden to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], where he could testify against Czerka Corporation, considering to recruit him for continuous work with SIS.<ref name="mail">{{TORcite|type=message|Life after Czerka!|Kamus Orden}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
In MMORPG ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' Fauler appears in the Republic planetary quest chain of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].
